dialogue.elder_bosses.malenia.intro_warn: I guard the Haligtree. You shall go no farther.
dialogue.elder_bosses.malenia.player_def: This path is closed to you.
dialogue.elder_bosses.malenia.transition: Then so be it... Let the scarlet bloom once more.
dialogue.elder_bosses.malenia.defeated: Miquella... still I could not... await your return.
